name: Casa Homenaje
notes: Sheet 0 (Verónica Durán Sela, Casa Homenaje, Gijón; the exterior is the single first photograph): a white, flat-roofed house on a lawn in open countryside - a white ground floor with a stone panel and a timber door and glass, a smaller first-floor volume faced in vertical natural timber with a recessed glazed bay, thin white fascias and a chimney stack, and a wide white flat-slab carport projecting forward on slim columns over a curving asphalt drive. Inside, wood floors, white walls, a double-height living room with a tall west window and a white stair (photographs 2 to 6; not modelled). Modelled: the white base, the timber volume and its glazing, the carport slab and columns, the drive, hedge, a few trees. Guessed: dimensions (a 17 x 10 m footprint), the sides and back (only the front-left is shown), the lawn's extent. A private home placed at its town only (Gijón).
